defects.description: The term 'value' is incorrectly translated as 'замечание' (remark/note) instead of 'значение'.
The term 'defaults' (referring to default values) is incorrectly translated as 'замечания по умолчанию' (default remarks).
Broken grammar and literal substitution; the phrase 'analytical-task reviews' is translated as a non-grammatical string of words.
